summary: FBS Global Limited, a Singapore-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its September 13, 2026 extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders of record as of September 2, 2026, with 13,500,000 ordinary shares outstanding, approved by ordinary resolution a 1-for-10 share consolidation, converting ten US$0.001 shares into one US$0.01 share, cutting authorized shares from 500,000,000 to 50,000,000 while authorized capital stays US$500,000. Turnout was 8,919,460 shares, or 66.07%, all voting in favor with no abstentions. This routine capital-structure action is not a special situation. Watch implementation timing, fractional-share rounding treatment, and any subsequent Nasdaq minimum-bid compliance effect.
